text.text_excerpt: This was a really nice hotel and I'm very glad we had the chance to stay here. We requested a room in the Hermann House courtyard so that we'd have a little jacuzzi in our room- I used it every night. It was awesome! King size bed was really comfortable and flat screen tv had tons of channels. There was a hot tub outside but we never used it since we had the jacuzzi. We also didn't make use of the salt water pool in the main hotel, which I kind of regret. I was so glad this place was a little bit further away from Bourbon St. and pretty quiet when I was ready to sleep. We stayed here for a few nights this past New Years. It's in a great location right off Bourbon street, which is convenient since it's close enough to the action but far enough from the crowds. Our room was spacious and the quality and amenities were satisfactory. There's also a cute pool in the courtyard which is a nice touch. Attached is a bar where they serve breakfast every morning. The bar was a cute spot for happy hour / pre-dinner drinks on your way out.

What a cool place! Here's something very important to note: EVERY ROOM IS DIFFERENT! We were in a group with 3 couples, each with their own room. I saw all 3, plus a selection of a few others (The staff let us go check out rooms to decide which one we liked)! All the rooms were the same price, but they were all VERY different. Some were huge, some were very small. Some had jacuzzi tubs, some did not. Some had balconies, some had views, some had windows. Some had very high, vaulted ceilings, and the rooms across the way in the carriage house had brick walls. We ended up choosing a room with 2 double beds on the 3rd floor, overlooking Dauphine street.
